sensors.title: Vigil — sensors
sensors.description: Pick your monitored sensors once. Every arming mode watches all of them; use a mode's exclusion list only to make that mode ignore specific sensors (e.g. Home ignores the lounge). Approach sensors (outdoor person detection) don't trigger the alarm — they boost the confidence of indoor movement seen around the same time.
